title: Share Files
description: Settings for the Share Files extension. Toggles take effect immediately - no reload required.

enableShares.title: Enable file sharing
enableShares.description: Show the 'My Shares' section, the 'Share Files...' context menu in the file browser, and the 'New Share' command. When off, you can still receive files via connections.

enableRequests.title: Enable file requests
enableRequests.description: Show the 'My Requests' section and the 'New Request' command. When off, you can still upload to other people's requests via connections.

showHiddenFiles.title: Show hidden files
showHiddenFiles.description: Show files and folders whose name starts with a dot (.env, .ssh, .ipynb_checkpoints, ...). Useful for sharing config files between team members.

tunnelAutostart.title: Start the Cloudflare tunnel automatically
tunnelAutostart.description: When a Cloudflare tunnel is configured (cloudflare setup), bring it up at server startup so links are public. Off by default - the server starts with private links; the cloud icon in the panel header toggles the tunnel on demand.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the panel polls the server for changes - new uploads to your requests, updated connections, and all of your shares and requests. Lower values refresh faster but make more requests. Minimum 2 seconds.
